% savepos-marginpar.tex -- acceptance gate: \marginpar side/column
% and deferred-footnote positions under d-tate, measured with savepos
% in the LOGICAL frame (inner-frame X = reading vertical) and compared
% against upLaTeX same-source numbers (see docs/pdftex-internals.md
% 縦組み脚注パリティの数値表 for the recorded table).
%
% Method: a savepos marker inside the marginpar box and inside the
% footnote text records the raw origin; the fixture converts ONCE
% (X - origin terms, the same single conversion the class's
% \jlreq@calc@current@linewidth performs) and prints:
%   MPAR-POS : marginpar marker position along the line direction
%              (logical X, pt from the line head) + raw savepos X.
%   FNOTE-POS: deferred footnote marker position along the line
%              direction + raw savepos X.
% The runner compares both engines' converted numbers (0.1pt).
% Deferred-note scenario: the footnote is declared on page 1 but its
% text is inserted at the bottom of the SAME page after a forced
% \clearpage boundary flush in twoside mode (the note travels with the
% insertion register, not the page break).
\documentclass[pdflatex,tate,paper=b5,twoside,line_length=20zw]{jlreq}
\makeatletter
\newcount\mp@n \mp@n=0
% savepos helper (pdflatex branch of the class machinery; the uplatex
% variant is produced by the runner with the same body via \savepos).
\def\mp@mark#1{%
  \global\advance\jlreq@reference@count by 1
  \jlreq@ifprimitive{\pdfsavepos}{\pdfsavepos}{\savepos}%
  \jlreq@ifprimitive{\pdfsavepos}{%
    \jlreq@reference@label{#1.X.\the\jlreq@reference@count}{\noexpand\the\noexpand\pdflastxpos}%
    \jlreq@reference@label{#1.Y.\the\jlreq@reference@count}{\noexpand\the\noexpand\pdflastypos}%
  }{%
    \jlreq@reference@label{#1.X.\the\jlreq@reference@count}{\noexpand\the\noexpand\lastxpos}%
    \jlreq@reference@label{#1.Y.\the\jlreq@reference@count}{\noexpand\the\noexpand\lastypos}%
  }%
  \expandafter\xdef\csname #1@n\endcsname{\the\jlreq@reference@count}%
}
\def\mp@read#1{%
  \expandafter\edef\csname mp@name\endcsname{#1.X.\csname #1@n\endcsname}%
  \jlreq@resultdimen=\expandafter\jlreq@reference@ref\csname mp@name\endcsname{0} sp\relax}
\begin{document}
% ---- marginpar side/column (odd page)
あいうえおかきくけこさしすせそ\marginpar{%
  \mp@mark{mpar}%
  傍注本文}%
たちつてとないぬねの。
\clearpage
% ---- deferred footnote (even page): declared mid-line, flushed at
% the bottom of the same column; marker inside the note text.
はひふへほまみむめもやゆよらりるれろ\footnote{%
  \mp@mark{fnote}%
  遅延脚注本文。}わをん。
\clearpage
% report pass-2 values (pass 1 has no aux origins)
\ifnum\jlreq@reference@count>0
  \mp@read{mpar}%
  \@tempdima=\dimexpr\jlreq@resultdimen\relax
  \typeout{MPAR-POS: x=\the\@tempdima,
    oddside=\the\oddsidemargin, hoffset=\the\hoffset,
    totalleft=\the\@totalleftmargin}%
  \mp@read{fnote}%
  \@tempdima=\dimexpr\jlreq@resultdimen\relax
  \typeout{FNOTE-POS: x=\the\@tempdima,
    oddside=\the\oddsidemargin, hoffset=\the\hoffset}%
\fi
\end{document}
